pages.title: Getting the Hang of It
pages.text: Record the first successful ability use for your chosen race.

pages.title: Getting the Hang of It
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the ability under the conditions shown on its race screen. An empty key press is not a successful use.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Ancestors use Choir of Life healing; native race screen explains passive benefits and oath limits. Read current bindings in Controls.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Void Walkers have Rift Ambush, void projectile and gravity control; mind water weakness and health tradeoff. Read current bindings in Controls.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Born in Bloom use roots, Living Path and daytime nature benefits; fire and barren environments require preparation. Read current bindings in Controls.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Infected by Sculk use echo sight, Sculk Veins and echo absorption; depth, sunlight and connected sculk matter. Read current bindings in Controls.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Nether Hearteds use lava powers and Infernal Eruption; water and frost remain special conditions. Read current bindings in Controls.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Choice, successful powers and mastery belong to one race owner. Reselection follows native screen eligibility; quests neither grant a race nor require cycling through all five.
